This '''holocron''' was found on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], dropped by a [[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] on the top of a [[Hardcell-class interstellar transport/Legends|''Hardcell''-class interstellar transport]]. A [[Clone jet trooper/Legends|clone jet trooper]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] recovered the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] and took it back to [[Checkpoint Alpha]].
